comment: The pre-launch scripts an attested app-compose may carry (deploy/verify-attestation.sh): Phala Cloud's default, which it adds to every app-compose, reviewed by its SHA-256. A new version fails verification until it is reviewed from a Deploy record's attestation.json and added here (deploy/README.md, "Attestation, ingress, and egress").

scripts.name: Phala Cloud Pre-Launch Script v0.0.20
scripts.seen: the attested app-compose of all 19 successful staging Deploy runs of 2026-09-29 and 2026-09-30, e.g. 36769082508
